flowCaptureHarness.caseSelector: Replace <scene> with the shot spec stem (e.g. boards). Specs live in frontend/cypress/e2e/shots/<scene>-shots.cy.ts. Set FLOW_CAPTURE_BASE_URL or CYPRESS_BASE_URL to reuse an already-running local-auth frontend; otherwise the runner boots Next on :3010.
